Hero.description: Learn Real English with Movies & TV Shows
Hero.h1: Modern online platform with interactive English video lessons
Hero.h2: Watch, break down phrases, and practice in context — not theory

Onbording.title: Welcome to Watch and Learn!
Onbording.descriptionInterface: This determines the language of your interface; what you see on the screen. We recommend choosing English, even if your level is beginner. However, you can skip this step and select your preference later using the interface language switch wich will be available fro you in your profile.
Onbording.discriptionStudy: This determines the language used for explanations and translations. For example, if you want to see the meaning of a word or phrase, it will be translated into language you will choose. Since this is a Ukrainian product, the interface language is currently available in English or Ukrainian only.

EnteringForms.name: Name
EnteringForms.signupSuccess: Check your email to confirm your account.

Lessons.title: Lessons
Lessons.instructionIntro: Watch the clip first, then use the selected lesson mode to work through the dialogue line by line.
Lessons.instructionToggle: Use the switch in the top bar if you want to move the video and lesson key to the left side of the page.
Lessons.instructionKey: Open the lesson key lines whenever you need the script, translation, or takeaways for a specific line.
Lessons.instructionEasy: Drag the missing words into the blank spots under the script.
Lessons.instructionMedium: Type the missing words into the inputs while following the script and the video.
Lessons.instructionHard: Work from the hidden structure and type each word correctly to reveal the line step by step.
